noah (eng-platform): Flagging an incident: customers on older SDKs are seeing misattributed quota usage after the routing-policy header rollout. Dashboard shows multiple small route rows for the same tenant.

tara (devex): getting support pings. Main complaint: weird spikes and duplicated route lines in console. Folks panic thinking they're burning through quota.

ivan (sdk-go): quick note: go-sdk 1.8 emits `X-Redwood-Routing: shard=2;priority=1` where priority is numeric. TS/py SDKs currently use string priorities (`'low'`). That mismatch makes the derived route fingerprint differ.

parul (sdk-ts): also some infra proxies rewrite header names to Title-Case which our ingestion sees as different keys. We tried to be liberal with parsing but edge cases leaked.

ben (console): console groups by the raw parsed route_key. If the same logical route appears with multiple fingerprints we show multiple rows. We can implement a best-effort canonicalizer that normalizes priority and casing. Short-term UI collapse likely.

noah (eng-platform): proposal: immediate ingest-side normalizer to parse structured header into canonical object: {tenant, shard:int, priority:lowercase-string} and emit a canonical route_id. That fixes downstream dashboards and quota ledgers. Also add `route_source` metadata to indicate original header variant.

telemetry-bot: scheduled task 'normalize-routing-headers' queued (job-512) ETA 45m.

tara (devex): communications: status page + in-console banner explaining artifact causes and ETA for fix. We should include migration guidance for SDK owners.

ivan (sdk-go): will cut go-sdk 1.9 with explicit normalizer and helper to produce canonical header (priority -> string) and document breaking change window. It's a small behavioral change but might affect any user depending on numeric priority. We'll add opt-out flag.

parul (sdk-ts): TS SDK can add a compatibility shim that emits legacy `X-Route-Id` when a feature-flag is set, and add a helper to emit canonical `X-Redwood-Routing` for new apps. We'll include snippet in migration docs.

ben (console): short-term action: collapse rows with semantically equivalent parsed route ids and tag them with a tooltip "Normalized from multiple header variants". Long-term: switch consoles to use the canonical route_id field from telemetry.

noah (eng-platform): also want to avoid future footguns: add a header contract doc to API spec (exact header name, field types). We'll schedule a breaking-change window and coordinate SDK releases & console/inference ingestion changes.

tara (devex): I'll draft the status update + migration notes. Also prep a small FAQ for customers pinned to older SDKs.

ivan (sdk-go): note to ops: if ingestion normalizer is rolled back, it might cause double-counting again. Please include canary checks for quota divergence.

telemetry-bot: normalization job started (job-512 run-1) :rocket:.

parul (sdk-ts): sample migration snippet for docs:```js
// ts-sdk canonical routing helper
client.request({route:{shard:2, priority:'low'}})
// sends: X-Redwood-Routing: shard=2;priority=low
```

noah (eng-platform): OK. Action log: 1) infra run normalize job (in-flight). 2) SDK teams prepare minor releases with canon helpers and opts. 3) console change to collapse rows + show route_source. 4) API spec update + scheduled breaking-change window. We'll sync again after job completes. :+1:
